body: Have you ever encountered the problem of night falling, mobs already roaming the streets, and no bed? This mod will solve that problem once and for all! When night falls, just look at the floor, press Shift + Right Click, and you'll be fast asleep. I recommend sleeping by a fire, otherwise you'll lose a bit of health in the morning from sleeping on the cold floor.
